description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire, Unlimited Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire Abilities, Fire Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Frontal Assault (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Fire/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/4 Samurai/T0 members
WS Blue: PHY Damage +50% to user
WS Gold: PHY Damage +30% to all allies
